title: Object lifting of an adic system through the explicit pushforward tower
statement: Let X be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], T_n, i_n, j_n, hi_n and ai_n be as in [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-system-pushforward-functor], and J an ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Assume j_n is a closed immersion with kernel J^(n+1). For every H in CoherentFormalModule X J [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], there exists a coherent thickening system M [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system] and an isomorphism of inverse systems P(M)≅H.obj, where P is the explicit functor. No Full, Faithful, equivalence structure or evaluation comparisons are asserted.

proof.text: The closed sources are Noetherian. Convert H_n annihilation to annihilation by the ideal-sheaf kernel using inverse-image ideal annihilation for the identity immersion. Quasi-coherence comes from coherence. Apply the coherent closed-immersion equivalence and its inverse and counit to construct the coherent term M_n and its pushforward identification e_n.

Conjugate each transition of H by e_(n+1), e_n and the pushforward-composition comparison. Surjectivity of the fully faithful closed pushforward map produces u_n : M_(n+1) → i_(n,*)M_n with exactly this pushforward.

Apply the single adjacent invertibility obligation to u_n and its displayed square. Form the comparison isomorphism from its adjoint using asIso and explicitly assemble the coherent terms and comparisons into R.

The adjunction hom equivalence applied to its inverse returns u_n. The specified pushed transitions therefore commute with e_n, by the chosen pushforward equation and inverse identities. Apply the proved assembly theorem to get P(R) ≅ H.obj.
